$comment: Frozen wire-contract envelope plus per-payload schemas. The envelope header (everything except `result`) is a stable contract; payloads evolve additively within a result_version. See src/wire.rs.

phase.description: Stable phase label, such as `"indexing"`, `"baseline"`, or `"replay"`.

schema.description:
Versioned progress event emitted to stderr while `--json` commands are running.

This uses the generic CLI event envelope header. The `event_type` /
`event_version` pair identifies the typed payload field (`progress` here).

event_version.description: Schema version of this event type's payload.

schema_version.description: Version of this CLI event envelope structure.

schema.title: CliProgressEvent

schema.description: Structured result returned by `bench baseline calibrate`.
schema.title: BaselineCalibrationResult

schema.description: Structured result returned by chainstate indexing.
schema.title: IndexResult

ChainstateJson.description: JSON serialization shape for a chainstate.

BaselineSummaryJson.description: Empty-block baseline attached to a benchmark run, if any.

ModeSummary.description: Resolved benchmark mode and sampling plan.

isolation.description: Physical isolation semantics for this run.

logical_targets.description: Number of logical targets in the run. Range mode reports `1`.

sample_unit.description: What one measured entry primarily samples.

total_entries.description: Total scheduled replay entries, including warmup entries.

warmup_entries.description: Scheduled warmup entries, discarded from metrics.

RunSummaryJson.description: Aggregated benchmark metrics for JSON output.

TargetKind.description: Discriminator for what kind of target a [`TargetSummary`] describes.

TargetSummary.description:
Per-target measurement summary. Emitted in [`RunResult::targets`] for
multi-target runs so downstream tooling can attribute metrics back to the
specific txid or block being benchmarked.

identifier.description: Hex txid (txid mode) or hex block id (block mode).

parent_block.description: Height of the parent block from which each replay was forked.

summary.description:
Aggregated measurement summary for this target. `None` if no
measurements were recorded (e.g. interrupted before completing any
measured iteration).

schema.description: Structured result returned by benchmark runs.

targets.description:
Per-target summaries. `None` for range mode and for single-`--txid`
runs (preserves the legacy flat output shape). `Some(...)` whenever
the run targets more than one transaction or block.

schema.title: RunResult

RunJson.description: JSON serialization shape for a benchmark run.

RunSummaryJson.description: Inline summary metrics for a benchmark run in list output.

schema.description: JSON output for benchmark run details.
schema.title: ShowResult

envelope.description:
Stable JSON envelope wrapping every structured command result.

Every field except `result` is part of the frozen header contract (see
the [module docs](self)). `result` carries the version-specific payload,
whose shape is fully described by (`result_type`, `result_version`).

duration_secs.description: Wall-clock duration of the command, in seconds.

result.description: The version-specific result payload; present iff `success` is `true`.

result_type.description: Discriminator for the `result` payload (`"error"` on failure).

result_version.description: Schema version of the `result` payload contract (`0` on failure).

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope structure. See [`ENVELOPE_SCHEMA_VERSION`].

envelope.title: CommandResult
